title: Staying in California and marriage
summary: He refused to go to New York with Oliver and married in California in 1927.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: You never recorded with King Oliver, I guess, any time? No, I didn't get it.

No, I left, you see. That's what he was going to do because he wanted to go to New York. I told him I ain't going to go to New York. I'm going to stay here. I get my shoes shined the whole year around in California.
I ain't got your car and I ain't got your California woman. I ain't leaving. I said, yeah, I'm going to stay here. Yeah. All right.
Your wife came from Chicago, I believe she said the other day. When were you married? Yeah.
She comes to Chicago. That's right.
Oh, I don't know. But I didn't, I didn't, I didn't, not in Chicago here. It was over, out here. Out here, yeah, in 1927.
So you came here in about 1921 and then in the state?
I come down in 21 states, yeah. No, 21, I come down, yeah, in 21 and I went back to Oakland, played around there. But I come back to Oakland, but I come back to the state.
